JourneyIQ Supply Chain Diagnostic

From fragmented operating data to a prioritised case for action.

A service-led diagnostic for regulated manufacturers, MedTech businesses and complex operating networks. Technology supports the work; the proposition is the quality, speed and traceability of the diagnosis.

Typical duration2–4 weeks
Starting point1 question
Data boundaryBounded
Result90-day plan

What is in scope

A defined operational question—such as declining OTIF, rising inventory, repeated expediting, network underperformance or a control queue—tested against the minimum evidence needed to make the next management decision.

What your team provides

  • An accountable sponsor and named operational owner.
  • A small set of ERP exports, spreadsheets or operational records agreed during scoping.
  • Working sessions with the people who own the relevant hand-offs.
  • Review and approval of definitions, assumptions and calculations.

What you receive

  • An executive diagnostic describing where performance and value are being lost.
  • A traceable evidence trail, including data-quality caveats and assumptions.
  • An opportunity register that keeps observed issues separate from estimated value.
  • A prioritised 90-day roadmap, with first tests, owners and review points.

Good fit

  • Regulated manufacturing and MedTech
  • ERP-enabled operations relying on spreadsheet and email workarounds
  • Cross-functional problems spanning suppliers, planning, logistics and internal hand-offs
  • Leaders who need a diagnostic before a major systems programme

Not designed for

  • Clinical or patient-facing decisions
  • Replacing a quality-management system
  • Promising savings before evidence is agreed
  • A generic dashboard implementation

Engagement steps

Four stages, with a decision gate at each one.

Map

Agree the journey boundary, event sequence, definitions and evidence request.

Measure

Build the baseline and show data quality alongside service, inventory, time and cost.

Diagnose

Connect symptoms to root causes and test alternative explanations.

Rebuild

Prioritise the first interventions, ownership, dependencies and review points.

A useful diagnostic should narrow the decision before it widens the programme.
